title: Add peer management subcommands to operator CLI
description:
Add to the transit operator CLI: 'transit peer-list' (show all peers with score and blacklist status), 'transit peer-blacklist <peer_id> [duration]' (manually blacklist), 'transit peer-unblacklist <peer_id>' (clear blacklist), 'transit peer-score <peer_id>' (show detailed metrics). Artifact: transit/src/cli/peers.rs.

Acceptance: all four subcommands work against a running daemon; peer-list output is tabular with columns: peer_id, address, score, status, last_seen; JSON output flag available
